## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The change is local-only; it does not introduce network calls, telemetry, accounts or sync.
- [ ] `npm run type-check`, `npm run type-check:electron` and `npm run lint` all pass.
- [ ] I tested the change in a real Electron build (`npm start`).
- [ ] User-facing strings go through `react-i18next` and exist in both `en` and `fr` locales.
- [ ] No secrets, hardcoded URLs, personal identifiers or third-party API keys are included.
